heart_charm.name: Heart Charm
heart_charm.description: +40 max health. Heals 0.3% of max health per second in fights.

war_banner.name: War Banner
war_banner.description: 8% on attack: the whole squad gets +25% attack speed for 2s.

shield_totem.name: Shield Totem
shield_totem.description: 6% chance to block a hit completely. Block from all items stops at 60%.

quick_gloves.name: Quick Gloves
quick_gloves.description: +18% attack speed. 8% on attack: hit twice.

bulwark_plate.name: Bulwark Plate
bulwark_plate.description: +35 defense, 8% chance to block a hit completely, -15 evasion. Block from all items stops at 60%.

siege_cannon.name: Siege Cannon
siege_cannon.description: Skills deal +110% damage. 15% chance a skill also hits nearby enemies.

bloodlust_mask.name: Bloodlust Mask
bloodlust_mask.description: +42% attack speed. Heals 5% of damage dealt; 10% chance to share it with the squad.

gamblers_dice.name: Gambler's Dice
gamblers_dice.description: +20 crit chance. Crits deal +70% and add a random debuff.

fire_bombs.name: Fire Bombs
fire_bombs.description: 8% on attack: throw a bomb for 300% fire damage.

chill_band.name: Chill Band
chill_band.description: Every attack adds a small ice hit (10%) and 1 Chill. 5 Chill = Freeze.

static_crystal.name: Static Crystal
static_crystal.description: 5% on attack: lightning for 420% that jumps to 2 more enemies and Shocks them.

aid_kit.name: Aid Kit
aid_kit.description: When a hero drops below 30% health, this hero patches them for 8% of their max health (10s cooldown).

shared_potion.name: Shared Potion
shared_potion.description: Every living hero heals 25% of max health.

sucker_punch_glove.name: Sucker Punch Glove
sucker_punch_glove.description: Enemies above 90% health take +50% damage from this hero (attacks, skills and items).

bandage_roll.name: Bandage Roll
bandage_roll.description: Every 6s, the most hurt hero loses 1 debuff and gets +8 defense for 6s.

second_wind_flask.name: Second Wind Flask
second_wind_flask.description: Used up: below 20% health, this hero heals 80% (once per floor).

full_vigor.name: Full Vigor
full_vigor.description: +15% damage while this hero is above 90% health.

brawlers_streak.name: Brawler's Streak
brawlers_streak.description: Each hit in a row: +2% damage (max +10%). Lost when stunned, frozen or feared.

tough_skin.name: Tough Skin
tough_skin.description: Every hit on this hero deals 2 less (never below 1).

kindling.name: Kindling
kindling.description: Every attack adds a small fire hit (15%). +15% fire damage (Burn too).

frost_charm.name: Frost Charm
frost_charm.description: Every attack adds a small ice hit (15%). +15% ice damage.

storm_charm.name: Storm Charm
storm_charm.description: Every attack adds a small electric hit (15%). +15% electric damage.

shadow_charm.name: Shadow Charm
shadow_charm.description: Every attack adds a small dark hit (15%). +15% dark damage.

ember_charm.name: Ember Charm
ember_charm.description: 6% on attack: Burn the enemy for 3s.

rusty_nails.name: Rusty Nails
rusty_nails.description: 8% on attack: Armor Break the enemy (less defense, stacks).

serrated_edge.name: Serrated Edge
serrated_edge.description: 10% on attack: make the enemy Bleed.

hex_doll.name: Hex Doll
hex_doll.description: 8% on attack: Curse the enemy (less resist, stacks).

dread_bell.name: Dread Bell
dread_bell.description: 5% on attack: Fear the enemy for 1s.

gag_rune.name: Gag Rune
gag_rune.description: Stuns and freezes from this hero also Silence the enemy for 2s.

magma_core.name: Magma Core
magma_core.description: Every attack adds a fire hit (35%). Burns deal +40% damage.

shatter_hammer.name: Shatter Hammer
shatter_hammer.description: +85% damage to frozen enemies (breaks the freeze), +14% to chilled ones.

blood_chalice.name: Blood Chalice
blood_chalice.description: +28% damage to bleeding enemies. Killing one heals 3%.

plague_flask.name: Plague Flask
plague_flask.description: Poison deals +28% damage. When a poisoned enemy dies, 15% of its Poison spreads to another enemy.

exploiters_lens.name: Exploiter's Lens
exploiters_lens.description: +42% damage to enemies with 3 or more different debuffs.

hunters_sigil.name: Hunter's Sigil
hunters_sigil.description: The first hit on each enemy Marks it: +14% damage from the squad.

thousand_cuts.name: Thousand Cuts
thousand_cuts.description: 8% on melee attack: Bleed. Every Bleed gets an extra stack. Bleeding enemies burst into knives when they die.
thousand_cuts.perStack: +8% chance, +10% bleed damage, bigger knife burst

frozen_thunderbolt.name: Frozen Thunderbolt
frozen_thunderbolt.description: Electric hits add a small ice hit (30%) and 1 Chill. At 3 Chill (or Frozen) the enemy shatters: 150% ice on it and its neighbours.

warding_charm.name: Warding Charm
warding_charm.description: Shield of 8% max health at the start of every fight and every 10s. Shields on this hero are 20% bigger.

overheal_ring.name: Vital Band
overheal_ring.description: Heals 0.2% of max health per second in fights.

spiked_aegis.name: Spiked Aegis
spiked_aegis.description: While this hero has a shield, melee attackers take 40% of their hit back.

provokers_horn.name: Provoker's Horn
provokers_horn.description: 18% on attack: Taunt the enemy for 3s. Taunted enemies take +15% damage.

spite_mail.name: Spite Mail
spite_mail.description: While this hero is taunting: +30 defense and reflects 25% of melee damage.

martyrs_shield.name: Martyr's Shield
martyrs_shield.description: +20 defense. When an ally drops below 30% health, this hero takes all hits meant for them for 3s (20s cooldown).

fire_heart.name: Fire Heart
fire_heart.description: Each floor starts with a fire shield (20% max health) that burns attackers and explodes when it breaks.

lost_clerics_grimoire.name: Lost Cleric's Grimoire
lost_clerics_grimoire.description: Healing on this hero is stored; at 10% of max health it bursts out as a green fireball (350%).

conductors_baton.name: Conductor's Baton
conductors_baton.description: Support skills are 25% stronger and last 25% longer.

echo_rune.name: Echo Rune
echo_rune.description: 15% chance a skill casts twice (the echo has 60% power).

rat_cage.name: Rat Cage
rat_cage.description: A Rat joins every fight, then another every 12s.

wisp_lantern.name: Wisp Lantern
wisp_lantern.description: A flying Wisp (shock bolts) joins every fight, then another every 15s. Wisps get half this hero's +electric damage.

fire_imp_brazier.name: Fire Imp Brazier
fire_imp_brazier.description: A fire Imp (its hits Burn) joins every fight, then another every 10s. Imps get half this hero's +fire damage.

mimic_chest.name: Mimic Chest
mimic_chest.description: 10% when this hero is hit: a Mimic pops out. It never attacks: it taunts the enemies around it, then explodes when it dies.

gargoyle_idol.name: Gargoyle Idol
gargoyle_idol.description: Summons a slow, tough Gargoyle whose hits Taunt enemies.

spirit_knight_banner.name: Spirit Knight Banner
spirit_knight_banner.description: Summons an Ice Spirit Knight (ice hits) that grows stronger every floor it survives. It gets half this hero's +ice damage.

phoenix_hatchling.name: Phoenix Hatchling
phoenix_hatchling.description: Summons a flying Phoenix whose fire hits Burn. It heals itself 2% per second and gets half this hero's +fire damage.

bone_charm.name: Bone Charm
bone_charm.description: All minions get +20% health and attack.

overseers_whistle.name: Overseer's Whistle
overseers_whistle.description: +1 weak minion allowed. Weak minions attack 15% faster and have 25% more health.

grave_dust.name: Grave Dust
grave_dust.description: Weak minions explode when they die (400% of their attack) and Poison the enemies hit.

necro_crown.name: Necro Crown
necro_crown.description: All minions +20% health and attack, weak minions come 50% faster, every kill raises a skeleton.

jolly_banner.name: Jolly Banner
jolly_banner.description: 5% on attack: this hero and an ally get regen, sure crits and +40% attack speed for 2s.

excalibur.name: Excalibur
excalibur.description: 8% on melee attack: a tornado drifts between enemies for 5s (max 3).

quiver_of_plenty.name: Quiver of Plenty
quiver_of_plenty.description: Ranged attacks: 25% chance to shoot an extra arrow at another enemy.

spotters_lens.name: Spotter's Lens
spotters_lens.description: The enemy you tap (or order a hero onto) takes +20% damage from the squad.

giantslayers_brand.name: Giantslayer's Brand
giantslayers_brand.description: +42% damage to bosses. Boss wind-ups take 20% longer.

catalyst_vial.name: Catalyst Vial
catalyst_vial.description: This hero's burn, poison and bleed ticks can crit (crit chance) and crits deal +25% more.

scholars_bookmark.name: Scholar's Bookmark
scholars_bookmark.description: +8% skill damage for every page on this hero's skills (modifier pages count twice).

mirror_buckler.name: Mirror Buckler
mirror_buckler.description: 12% chance a ranged or magic hit on this hero bounces back.

soul_lantern.name: Soul Lantern
soul_lantern.description: Only once per run. Every 8 kills: +1% attack and max health for the rest of the run.

phoenix_feather.name: Phoenix Feather
phoenix_feather.description: Used up: when this hero would die, they live, are invulnerable for 1s and heal to 70%.

iron_will_talisman.name: Iron Will Talisman
iron_will_talisman.description: +6 resist. Stuns, freezes, webs and fears on this hero are 25% shorter.

flame_spirit.name: Dark Spirit
flame_spirit.description: 8% on attack: 3-5 dark spirit orbs strike random enemies (500% each).

spirit_axe.name: Spirit Axe
spirit_axe.description: 8% when this hero is hit: a ghost axe spins once around them, hitting every nearby enemy for 400% damage.

heart_of_the_beast.name: Heart of the Beast
heart_of_the_beast.description: +100 max health. Heals 1% of max health per second in fights.

moonlight_twinblade.name: Moonlight Twinblade
moonlight_twinblade.description: 18% on attack: a moon crescent hits the enemy 3 times (110% each).

ghastly_fire.name: Ghastly Fire
ghastly_fire.description: Fire hits and burns from this hero also deal 28% as dark. Burning enemies attack 5% slower.

eclipse_idol.name: Eclipse Idol
eclipse_idol.description: Stores this hero's dark damage. When full, 2-3 random enemies are Doomed for 4s: 50% slower attacks, 35% less resist and 350% dark damage every second.

thunderstruck.name: Thunderstruck
thunderstruck.description: 5% on attack: a circle grows under the strongest enemy, then a giant THUNDERBOLT hits it for 700% (sets off your on-hit items).

guardians_banner.name: Guardian's Banner
guardians_banner.description: The whole squad gets +15 defense and +15 resist (while this hero lives).

assault_breastplate.name: Assault Breastplate
assault_breastplate.description: +35 defense. From 0.5s into each floor, every enemy has 8 less defense while this hero lives.

riposte_cloak.name: Riposte Cloak
riposte_cloak.description: +5 evasion. After this hero dodges a hit, it strikes back for 120% damage.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.description: Below 30% health: +40% damage and +20% attack speed.

harvest_scythe.name: Harvest Scythe
harvest_scythe.description: Critical hits heal this hero 8% of the damage dealt (at most 10% of max health per crit).

elites_badge.name: Elite's Badge
elites_badge.description: BOUNTY: when an elite dies, the squad heals 10% max health and gets +50% XP from it.

swarm_swatter.name: Swarm Swatter
swarm_swatter.description: +25% damage to normal enemies (not elites or bosses).

opening_horn.name: Opening Horn
opening_horn.description: First 4s of every floor: +30% attack speed.

quick_fingers.name: Quick Fingers
quick_fingers.description: Every kill: this hero's skill cooldowns -0.5s.

life_crystal.name: Life Crystal
life_crystal.description: 15% when any enemy dies: it drops a green orb that heals heroes near it 5% max health.

emergency_buckler.name: Emergency Buckler
emergency_buckler.description: Every kill: a shield of 6% max health that fades over 4s.

rally_flag.name: Rally Flag
rally_flag.description: Once per floor, when a hero drops below 30% health: every hero gets a 12% max health shield.

frost_mantle.name: Frost Mantle
frost_mantle.description: Hit by a melee attack: 30% chance to chill the attacker.

reapers_bell.name: Reaper's Bell
reapers_bell.description: Enemies this hero kills explode for 18% of their max health as dark damage nearby. Explosions can chain.

ice_bomb.name: Ice Bomb
ice_bomb.description: 8% on attack: throw a bomb for 300% ice damage that chills.

electric_bomb.name: Electric Bomb
electric_bomb.description: 8% on attack: throw a bomb for 300% electric damage that stuns for 1s.

dark_bomb.name: Dark Bomb
dark_bomb.description: 8% on attack: throw a bomb for 300% dark damage; the enemy deals 15% less damage for 4s.

poison_bombs.name: Poison Bombs
poison_bombs.description: 8% on attack: throw a poison bomb for 300% dark damage that adds 3 poison stacks.

bombardiers_barrel.name: Bombardier's Barrel
bombardiers_barrel.description: Bombs deal +100% damage. When a bomb goes off: 25% chance to throw 2-4 more bombs.

sweeping_strap.name: Sweeping Strap
sweeping_strap.description: Melee attacks also hit enemies next to the target for 15% damage.

kinetic_coil.name: Kinetic Coil
kinetic_coil.description: Every dodge stores a charge (max 3). The next attack deals +40% electric damage per charge.

sharpest_blade.name: Sharpest Blade
sharpest_blade.description: Pure steel: if this hero has no element, attacks deal +40% and every 5th is a HEART STRIKE: 500% + 15% of the enemy's max health (bosses 4%), stun 2.5s and -50% armor 5s. A kill makes the next one a Heart Strike too.
sharpest_blade.perStack: +20% pure damage, +50% and +5% max health on Heart Strikes

euclid_of_elements.name: Euclid of Elements
euclid_of_elements.description: Hits with 2 or more elements: 15% chance to cast 3 more times at 60% damage.

frozen_demon_head.name: Frozen Demon Head
frozen_demon_head.description: +50% ice damage. Ice damage fills the Head: Ice Spikes hit the strongest enemy for 700% and freeze it 5s. This hero deals no fire, electric or dark damage.
